title: Steuerberater (m/w/d) in Eberswalde, auf Wunsch mit Partnerperspektive, gesucht - mindestens 90.000€
description:

 Sie suchen eine positive berufliche Veränderung? Sie möchten den nächsten Schritt in Ihrer Karriere gehen und streben möglicherweise sogar eine Partnerschaft in einer zukunftsorientierten Kanzlei an? Sie möchten endlich wieder in einem positiven Arbeitsumfeld arbeiten, in dem Sie finanziell und persönlich wertgeschätzt werden? Sie suchen nach Tätigkeiten, die Sie auch wirklich weiterbringen? 
 Sofern Sie sich in mindestens einem der genannten Punkte wiederfinden, sollten Sie sich bei uns melden. Wir haben die attraktivsten Arbeitgeber der Steuerberatungsbranche in unserem Netzwerk und bringen zusammen, was zusammengehört. Grenzenlose Entwicklungschancen mit Partnermöglichkeiten, vielschichtige Tätigkeitsbereiche, Gehälter wie in der Industrie und vieles mehr – melden Sie sich bei uns und wir unterstützen Sie auf Ihrem weiteren Karriereweg! 
 Derzeit suchen wir nach einem Steuerberater (m/w/d) für eine unserer Partner-Kanzleien in Eberswalde 
 Bei  Rückfragen  kannst du dich gerne  jederzeit  (auch nach deinem Feierabend) direkt telefonisch an  Herrn Becker-Koch  über folgende Nummer wenden:  015901431130  
 Aufgaben 
 Wir bringen zusammen, was zusammengehört. Dabei spielt das passende Tätigkeitsprofil natürlich eine entscheidende Rolle. Bei unserer Partnerkanzlei können Sie sich Ihren Aufgabenbereich auf Basis Ihrer persönlichen Stärken und Schwächen selbst zusammenstellen.

  Begleitung  von  Betriebsprüfungen

  Weitere  individuell  wählbare Tätigkeitsbereiche , die Ihnen Freude bringen 
 
 Qualifikation 
 Am Ende sollte es für beide Seiten passen. Deshalb wäre es gut, wenn Sie sich in den folgenden Punkten wiederfinden. 
 
  Kommunikative Art  und Freude am Austausch mit Mandanten 
  Sorgfältige , effiziente und  gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise  
 Offen für eine  digitale Arbeitsweise  
  Führungsverständnis  und  Verantwortungsbewusstsein  gegenüber Mitarbeitern (optional) 
 Ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes  Steuerberaterexamen  
  Leidenschaft  für  steuerliche Themen  
 
 Benefits 
 Sie haben genug von 0815 Benefits, von denen Sie nicht wirklich profitieren? Dann sollten Sie einen Blick auf die nachfolgenden Benefits werfen. 
 
 Außerordentliche Vergütung von  90.000 € bis 130.000 €  / Jahr, auf Wunsch auch  Partnerperspektive  
  Flexible  Gestaltung der  Arbeitszeiten  sowie die Option auf  Home-Office  
  Nettolohnoptimierung  mit monatlichen 50,00€ Sachbezugsgutscheinen 
 Umfangreiche Unterstützung bei  Weiterbildungsmaßnahmen  wie z.B. Fachberater Qualifikationen 
  Modernste Ausstattung  mit digitalen Prozessen 
  Starker Teamzusammenhalt  und regelmäßige Teamevents 
 
 Schnell, unkompliziert und effizient Ihren Traumjob finden – ein Versprechen an Sie, dass wir aufgrund unseres selektiven, breit gefächerten und deutschlandweiten Kanzleinetzwerks halten werden. lhre Vorteile mit uns auf einen Blick: 
 
 Sie führen  keine unsinnigen Bewerbungsgespräche  mehr, bei denen Sie während des Bewerbungsprozesses merken, dass es (bspw. wegen des Gehalts) sowieso nicht passt - wir klären vor Ihrem Bewerbungsgespräch all Ihre mit uns besprochenen Kriterien mit der Kanzlei ab. 
  Wir führen Ihre Gehaltsverhandlungen  und kennen die Gehaltsstrukturen der Branche dabei bestens. 
  100% Anonymität  – solange Sie uns nicht das „Go“ geben und einem Kennenlernen mit Ihrem neuen potentiellen Arbeitgeber zustimmen, erfährt niemand von Ihrem Namen oder Ihren bisherigen Arbeitgebern – Ihre Ihnen wichtigen Kriterien können wir auch zunächst anonym mit unseren Partnerkanzleien klären. 
  Attraktive Kanzleien  – die Kanzleien in unserem breit gefächerten Kanzleinetzwerk sind selektiv ausgewählt und heben sich klar von “normalen” Kanzleien ab (z.B. hinsichtlich der Vergütung, Benefits, Hierarchien, Digitalisierungsgrad, Ausstattung etc.). 
 Und das Beste: Unser gesamter Service ist  unverbindlich und völlig kostenfrei  für Sie.

title: Senior Software Engineer (m/w/d) | Fullstack für KI-Produkte
description: Über uns  Wie bleibt ein RAG-System präzise, wenn aus tausend Dokumenten hunderttausend werden? Wie orchestriert man mehrere Modellanbieter sauber hinter einer Oberfläche? Während anderswo noch Prototypen gezeigt werden, arbeiten unsere Kunden längst damit - mit ihren Daten, ihren Regeln, gehostet in Deutschland. Als Senior Engineer verantwortest du Kernfunktionen und Architektur unserer Plattform, vom Retrieval bis ins Frontend - und du entwickelst sie so, wie wir arbeiten: AI-gestützt, mit Coding-Agents als Teil des Werkzeugkastens und mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum für deine Ideen. Du suchst eine Rolle, in der technische Tiefe und Produktverantwortung zusammenkommen? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen!   Das gibt es zu tun     Architektur & Umsetzung  Du entwirfst und skalierst verteilte Systeme und Microservices - immer mit Blick auf Wartbarkeit, Stabilität und die Frage, was in zwei Jahren noch trägt.    KI-Features bauen, die im Alltag halten  Du entwickelst die Kernfunktionen unserer Plattform - von RAG-basierten Wissensdatenbanken über KI-Apps für einzelne Fachbereiche bis zu Voice-, Übersetzungs- und Analytics-Funktionen.    Full-Stack liefern  Du entwickelst performante APIs, modellierst Daten und Datenbanken und setzt moderne Oberflächen im Frontend um - vom Retrieval bis zur Benutzeroberfläche.   Daten, Sicherheit & Mandantenfähigkeit  Du modellierst Daten für Multi-Tenancy und rollenbasierte Berechtigungen - so, dass niemand über die KI Zugriff auf etwas bekommt, das er nicht sehen darf. Verschlüsselung, Datenminimierung und Auditierbarkeit denkst du von Anfang an mit.    Betrieb & Observability mitdenken  Du sorgst dafür, dass Qualität, Kosten und Verhalten der KI-Features im Betrieb sichtbar bleiben - mit Evaluations, Monitoring und klaren Guardrails, damit die Plattform auch bei wachsender Nutzung stabil und effizient läuft.   Komplexität beherrschen  Du entwickelst bestehende Systeme weiter, schaffst klare Strukturen und reduzierst technische Schulden dort, wo sie langfristig teuer werden und lässt sie stehen, wo sie es nicht sind.    AI-gestützt entwickeln – und den Standard dafür setzen  Du arbeitest selbstverständlich mit Coding-Assistenten und Agenten, holst mehr aus ihnen heraus als Autocomplete und weißt genau, wo ihre Grenzen liegen. Neue Tools und Workflows testest du früh, bewertest sie ehrlich und etablierst im Team, wie wir sie sinnvoll einsetzen.   Team & Produkt weiterbringen  Du arbeitest eng mit Product Owner, UX und unseren Consultants zusammen, übersetzt echte Kunden-Use-Cases in Technik, machst technische Entscheidungen transparent und bringst unsere Junior Developer durch Code Reviews und Mentoring fachlich weiter.      Das bringst Du mit    Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Entwicklung komplexer Softwaresysteme, idealerweise im KI- bzw. SaaS/Cloud-Umfeld  Sehr gute TypeScript-Kenntnisse, Erfahrung mit Node.js und idealerweise Frameworks wie NestJS   Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Softwarearchitektur für verteilte Systeme - Microservices, API-Design, Skalierung   Erfahrung im Frontend, z. B. mit Vue.js, sowie ein gutes Verständnis für Full-Stack-Zusammenhänge   Fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Datenbanken (z. B. PostgreSQL), Datenmodellierung und Performance-Optimierung   Erfahrung mit Cloud-Plattformen (z. B. AWS), Docker und dem Betrieb von SaaS-Anwendungen   AI-gestütztes Entwickeln ist für dich Alltag: Du arbeitest routiniert mit Coding-Assistenten und -Agenten (z. B. Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot), kennst ihre Grenzen und prüfst generierten Code kritisch, statt ihm zu vertrauen   Du bist nah am Puls der Entwicklung: Du probierst neue Tools, Modelle und Workflows aktiv aus und bringst die guten ins Team - Erfahrung mit agentischen Setups (z. B. Coding-Agents in der Cloud, MCP-Integrationen, automatisierte Reviews) ist ein starkes Plus   Tieferes Verständnis moderner AI-/LLM-Konzepte wie RAG, Function Calling, Embeddings oder Agenten  Clean Code, Testing und Code Reviews sind für dich selbstverständlich und du bringst Junior Developers durch Reviews und Mentoring gern fachlich weiter   Du triffst technische Entscheidungen und kannst sie nachvollziehbar vertreten - auf Deutsch und auf Englisch   Erfahrung mit DSGVO, ISO 27001 oder dem EU AI Act sind ein Plus     Was uns wichtig ist   Frameworks kann man lernen. Was uns viel wichtiger ist: Verantwortung übernehmen, das Produkt mitdenken, Anforderungen konstruktiv hinterfragen und technische Entscheidungen treffen, die man auch in zwei Jahren noch begründen kann - pragmatisch abgewogen zwischen Perfektion und Geschwindigkeit. Konkret heißt das: Du entwirfst morgens die Architektur für ein neues Feature, reviewst mittags Pull Requests, entwickelst nachmittags selbst und bringst dabei unser Team fachlich weiter. Wer lieber Tickets abarbeitet und auf Anforderungen wartet, wird bei uns nicht glücklich.   Das bekommst Du     Start & Welcoming  so wie du es verdienst! Ein strukturiertes Onboarding mit echten A

title: Senior Product Designer (B2B SaaS Startup)
description: Our Mission   Join us in reshaping global trade in a fast-growing startup!  We are  traide AI  – a VC-backed, B2B deep tech startup based in Berlin, using AI to solve one of the most overlooked yet critical challenges in international trade: compliance. Our software automates product classification, reduces regulatory errors, and helps customers save up to 83% of their time on a process that is critical to get right.  Trusted by  leading brands like BMW, RIMOWA, OBI, Edeka , we've achieved  3  x growth over the past 12 months  – and we're just getting started.   Your tasks     Own the full loop.  Take a user problem from rough idea to shipped interface: partner or write the brief, design the flow, prototype it, partner with engineering, ship it with as few handoffs as possible.   Use AI as a force multiplier.  Explore and prototype with AI tools, Figma, or code, whatever gets there fastest. Your taste is the editorial layer: you know when AI-generated UI is wrong even when it looks right, and you fix it.   Solve from first principles.  Reason about the right interaction for the user problem instead of reaching for a component library.   Sweat the final 10%.  Craft the details others miss, the ones that make a compliance product feel trustworthy.   Work in small, focused pods.  No layers, no waiting. You'll work closely with two or three others who share the same model.   Be accountable to outcomes.  Know the metric your team is moving. Measure your week by what changed for users, not by screens delivered.   Stretch beyond design.  Read the API spec, engage users directly, build in code when it's faster than Figma.     Who we’re looking for  Craft is the baseline here, not a nice-to-have. What sets you apart is range and judgment: you know what good looks like, you know when something looks right but feels wrong, and you can get a team there with you.   Fluency in English (C1+) is required.  German (C1) is a plus, but not a must-have.  Genuine design craft with a track record: you've shipped interfaces real users navigated without explanation, and you can point to the metric that moved.  Strong visual sensibility, high standards, and an eye for detail.  Range across Design, Product, and Engineering: you've gone from user problem to testable prototype without waiting for a brief, and used AI coding tools to build something real. You're not dependent on an engineer to realize your vision.  You've built personal AI workflows that make you meaningfully faster, and you know when to trust, edit, or reject AI output.  Comfortable in ambiguity: you ship, collect signal, and iterate rather than waiting for full clarity.  You are excited to show your work (portfolio or examples).  Ideally you've worked on products where getting it wrong has real consequences (fintech, healthtech, logistics, compliance), but that's not a must-have.  Berlin-based or willing to relocate.   This role is not for you if…   You want a PM to define the problem and an engineer to implement the solution.  You resist working in code or with AI.  You hand off polished Figma files and believe your job is done.  You judge yourself on taste alone, not outcomes.      I nterview process:        First Call — Intro on what we do with Max (Hiring manager)   Second Call — Portfolio walkthrough with Sebastian (Designer)   Third Call — Get to know our product and culture with our Product team (group call)  On-site Day — Meet our team in our Berlin office and work on a real problem together with us.  (Potentially) quick ,,vibe check'' call- with founder (Leonie or Hendrik)      Why us?   What you can expect    Enjoy  benefits like an Urban Sports Club  membership   Varied day-to-day  → every problem comes with unique needs, so no two days are the same   Visible impact  → you'll see the direct results of your work for both our customers and traide AI   Direct impact on product  → your decisions ship and shape what users touch every day   Flexible working  → we work in a hybrid mode, with an office in senfelderplatz and home office options.   Be part of our  regular team events  (boat trips, bowling, etc.)    Find more  English Speaking Jobs in Germany  on Arbeitnow

title: Engineering Manager Embedded
description:
Our mission at  Qwello  is to revolutionize the charging industry, we are committed to turn the world from combustion to electric. We put the customer first. We know their needs and deliver results they love. We design, build and operate charging infrastructure for the public space. We excel in simplicity, user focus and engineering excellence. We value diversity of thought, background and approaches and foster a culture of belonging. We understand that the best products are built by excellent teams, not individual superstars. 
  Be part of shaping the E-mobility of the future!  
 We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our Embedded team - the team that designs, builds and ships Qwello's AC charging stations, from circuit board to firmware to the production line. This is not a pure software management role. Your team of 6-8 spans embedded software, electrical engineering and mechanical engineering, and your scope runs from the firmware release train for thousands of chargers in the field, through EMC labs and Eichrecht certification audits, to the contract manufacturer's factory floor. 
 Our firmware is built on embedded Linux (Yocto) and EVerest, the open source EV charging stack we actively contribute to upstream. We are working with Rust, Python, C & C++. You will not be the deepest specialist in any one of these - your tech leads are - but you must be technical enough to represent the team when they are not in the room, to challenge estimates, and to make trade-offs between firmware, hardware and regulatory constraints with confidence and competence. 
 If you have led embedded or hardware-adjacent teams, enjoy being the person to which a factory, a certification body and a firmware engineer all escalate in the same week, and who brings the self-organization to keep all of it moving without dropping balls, we would love to talk. 
  Please Note:  Tell us about a physical product you helped ship - what your team built, what went wrong on the way to production, and what your part in fixing it was. 
   Your Responsibilities 🚀   
 Lead and grow a team of 6-8 engineers across embedded software, electrical and mechanical engineering: 1:1s, performance reviews, compensation input, hiring and, when needed, structured performance management 
 Own delivery: quarterly planning and OKRs with leadership, translating requests from our country organizations into scoped, estimated engineering work, and saying no with a rationale when needed 
 Own the firmware release train (dev, canary, production) for the charger fleet and be answerable for fleet-impacting incidents alongside our operations teams 
 Drive certification and compliance as a permanent workstream: Eichrecht (Modul B and Modul D), CE and EMC campaigns, VDE and TÜV interactions, DSO assessments and upcoming regulation and technologies like vehicle-to-grid (V2G), changes to the AFIR and such 
 Manage key vendors and partners across the full bill of materials: our EVCC board supplier, meter vendors, payment terminal providers, the contract manufacturer running our production line, and our open source partners upstream 
 Keep production shippable: end-of-line testing, BOM changes and cost analysis, supply chain risk, and same-day escalation support when the factory line stops 
 Build a resilient team structure: develop tech leads, keep yourself off the critical path of IC work, and reduce bus factor on certification and hardware knowledge 
  Your Profile ✨  
 Several years of experience managing embedded, firmware or hardware-adjacent engineering teams, including hiring, performance reviews and difficult personnel conversations 
 A solid engineering background in embedded systems: you have shipped firmware or devices to production and can hold a technical argument with strong, opinionated senior engineers 
 Comfort with the physical side of the product: electronics, EMC, test labs, manufacturing. You do not need to design circuits, but this world must not be foreign to you 
 Demonstrated experience working with certification bodies, notified bodies or regulated products - or the appetite and rigor to own this quickly 
 Outstanding self-organization: this role has many parallel threads (people, releases, audits, vendors, factory), and following through reliably is the single most important skill 
 A track record of building self-managing teams: delegating, developing tech leads and staying off the critical path rather than being the hero 
 Excellent communication skills in English, from firmware engineers to executives to external auditors 

   Nice to have  

 German language skills - a significant part of our supplier, certification and authority communication runs in German 
 Experience in EV charging or e-mobility: OCPP, ISO 15118, Eichrecht, smart charging 
 Familiarity with embedded Linux (Yocto), EVerest or other open source involvement, Rust or modern C++ 
 Experience working with contract manufacturers and owning production or end-of-line

title: Senior Implementation Specialist Digital Analytics (w/m/d)
description: Your new team:  As an Implementation Specialist, you are right at the heart of our projects: You translate business requirements into robust technical tracking solutions, implement them, ensure their quality, and turn concepts into fully functioning digital analytics setups. You take full responsibility for digital analytics implementations from initial requirements through to go-live and act as a trusted advisor to our clients throughout the process.   What awaits you:    You analyze our clients’ requirements and translate business and analytics use cases into technically sound tracking and implementation concepts.  You develop and document tracking concepts, data models, and data layer requirements and align them with clients and developers.  You work with tag management systems, implement tracking and third-party tags, and ensure scalable data collection.  You conduct technical testing, debugging, and data validation and systematically investigate data quality issues.  You consider consent management, data protection, and technical requirements from the very beginning of the implementation process.  You work closely with Digital Analysts, Data Engineers, and Project Managers, acting as the technical interface between business and development.  You actively share your expertise within your team and help develop our standards, best practices, and ways of working.  Depending on the project, you may also support tool selection, architecture decisions, migrations, and the technical enablement of our clients.     What you can expect:   At FELD M, you won’t work within a traditional agency structure with rigid specializations. We bring together different disciplines and perspectives and see ourselves as The Data Collective.  You will have the opportunity to work with a diverse range of clients, industries, and technology setups while continuously expanding your expertise. We deliberately work independently of specific tools while bringing many years of expertise and strong partnerships with, among others, Google and Adobe. Our projects range from auditing and optimizing existing implementations to complete new implementations and migrations, as well as complex analytics and data setups. You also won’t work in isolation: At FELD M, the close connection between business, analytics, and technology is at the core of what we do. This intersection is what makes the role particularly exciting.  What else? We believe in People First and Sustainable Pace. Taking responsibility and delivering high-quality work does not mean constantly operating at full speed. We want to do great work sustainably – together, with mutual support and room for different lifestyles.We are looking for people who are curious, take ownership, and enjoy sharing their expertise. We don’t see job descriptions as rigid checklists. Instead, we want to understand how your experience, interests, and strengths fit the role and what we need as a team.   What you bring along:    You don’t need to know every tool. What matters more is that you have a strong understanding of digital analytics and can quickly familiarize yourself with new technologies and setups.  Several years of professional experience in digital analytics, web analytics, tracking, or MarTech implementation  Strong knowledge of at least one tag management system  Experience designing and implementing data layers and tracking concepts  A solid understanding of client-side and server-side tracking, as well as their respective technical requirements and capabilities  A solid technical understanding of web technologies, particularly JavaScript  Experience with testing and data validation of analytics implementations  An understanding of consent management, data protection, and the technical implications for tracking  The ability to explain technical concepts clearly to different stakeholders  A structured, analytical, and quality-oriented approach to your work  A genuine interest in taking ownership and not just analyzing technical challenges, but implementing solutions yourself  We look forward to meeting you! title: Quality Manager – Quality Control & Quality Assurance (all genders)
description: About the role:    We are a niche beauty startup dedicated to developing high-quality cosmetic products with a strong focus on natural ingredients and modern formulation science. Coordinate microbiological, stability, and preservative-efficacy (challenge) testing with external laboratories, and interpret results against acceptance criteria.      Lead investigation of out-of-specification results and contamination events, including root cause analysis, containment, and corrective and preventive action (CAPA) plans, in coordination with suppliers.      Maintain and continuously improve Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for quality control and quality assurance processes. Support internal audits of quality processes and prepare documentation for external audits and certification bodies. Act as the day-to-day quality contact for Production and Development, flagging quality risks before they reach the market.       What you offer us      3+ years of experience in Quality Control or Quality Assurance within cosmetics, personal care, or a comparable regulated industry.      Degree in a natural science field (Chemistry, Cosmetic Science, Biology, or comparable), or equivalent hands-on experience.      Working knowledge of ISO 22716 (Cosmetics GMP) and cosmetic microbiological testing and challenge testing (e.g. ISO 11930) principles.      Practical experience with root cause analysis and CAPA processes.      Comfortable reviewing batch records, certificates of analysis, and laboratory test reports independently.      Experience working with external testing laboratories and coordinating results against acceptance criteria.      Structured, hands-on, and comfortable owning documentation and quality decisions in a small-team startup environment.      Business-fluent  English and German , other languages are always a plus. Remaining up to date with SOPs, regulatory requirements and best practice guidance to maintain competence and ensure the highest standards of checking.     What do you need? Strong knowledge of pharmacy legislation, SOPs, governance requirements and patient safety principles.    The ability to work independently and make sound decisions while recognising the limits of your competence and escalating concerns appropriately.    Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to maintain concentration and accuracy, even when working at pace. title: Acoustic Researcher
description: Full-time · On-site (Paris Marseille Amsterdam)   The sea is the physical layer of the economy—the conduit for our energy, communications, and trade. It is also Europe’s exposed flank. Pelagon is building the answer.  Founded by  Aymeric  (serial deeptech entrepreneur; founded & exited Scortex, Leading AI solution for manufacturing quality) and  Gauthier  (Navy officer and McKinsey), Pelagon is building a foundational multimodal acoustic model for autonomous maritime protection (underwater and surface) in service of European sovereignty. It will be deployed on a distributed, autonomous network of vectors (UUVs, buoys, sailbuoys, seabed…) to provide real-time understanding of underwater threats.  France and Europe have world-class acoustic engineers and a long history in underwater warfare. By bridging this expertise with modern physical-AI strategies (as seen in autonomous driving and robotics). Europe is still missing it’s naval NeoPrime, Pelagon aims to become to lead the way in autonomous marine protection—from detection to interception—partnering with leading navies, primes, and neo-primes, while also operating its own fleet as a service.  Pelagon is backed by  Hexa , the pioneer startup studio in Europe, which has launched 35+ companies, including unicorns like Front, Aircall, and Spendesk, combining €230m+ ARR and €750m raised.      Why this matters   The sea is the physical layer of the economy — and Europe's most exposed flank. Everything that moves beneath the surface leaves an acoustic trace, but the ocean is a brutal channel: multipath, ambient noise, shifting propagation. Reading it is first and foremost a physics problem.  France and Europe have a world-class heritage in underwater acoustics and sonar. Pelagon's bet is to bridge that science with modern physical-AI strategies and a distributed fleet of UUVs, buoys, sailbuoys and seabed sensors. As our  Acoustic Researcher , you are the physics backbone of that system — the person who understands underwater sound deeply enough that our models can learn from it. You partner directly with our AI Engineers, who consume the features, representations and data you help define.   What you'll do     Model underwater sound propagation across realistic ocean environments to enable our synthetic data generation pipeline.    Characterize and classify acoustic signatures of surface and underwater targets; build the ground-truth understanding our multimodal acoustic model is trained against.    Design and reason about sensor and array geometries: what to deploy, where, and how to extract maximum information from constrained & distributed vectors.    Work hand in hand with AI Engineers on physics-constrained learning strategies ans models.     What we look for     Deep grounding in underwater acoustics, sonar, or a closely related field (ocean acoustics, radar/array processing, acoustic signal processing). PhD or equivalent research experience.    Strong command of statistical signal processing: detection & estimation theory, array processing, time-frequency analysis.    Fluent in Python (NumPy/SciPy) for modeling, simulation and analysis; comfortable working with large datasets.    A builder's instinct, you want your work deployed at sea, not left in a paper. Bias toward validating ideas against real data.    Bonus: prior experience using machine learning on acoustic signals, naval / defense domain experience.        Why join now      Founding ownership.  You'll be one of the first engineers and will define the technical foundation of the company. Meaningful equity comes with that.     A mission with weight.  This is hardware that protects critical infrastructure and Europe's maritime space.     Real things, in the real ocean, fast.  You'll see your work in the water within weeks, not years.     AI-first, at the edge, in the real world.  We train our own models and run them where it counts: in the water, on the device. You'll be solving the edge-ML and power problems most companies only talk about.     A sovereign, European deeptech at the inflection point  of a market with strong NATO and EU policy momentum behind it.    Find  Jobs in France  on Arbeitnow

description: About Customs Support Group         Customs Support Group (CSG) is the European market leader in customs services, operating across 15 countries. CSG is owned by private equity and a fast-growing, dynamic, data-driven company, dedicated to expanding its presence through strong organic growth and strategic acquisitions. Its key priorities include digital transformation, operational excellence and customer experience, all aimed at driving growth and enhancing efficiency.      The Role  You will take our AI stack and lead its development and customisation for the market.  This is a builder and do-er role. You will design, test and implement practical and compliant agentic AI solutions on top of foundation models document understanding, classification support, retrieval over our own procedures and tariff material, and agents that carry multi-step operational work end to end.  You are not being asked to train models from scratch. You are being asked to make models that already exist behave reliably enough that operations staff trust them with customs declarations, where being wrong has consequences.  Working closely with Operations, Transformation, IT and Group teams, you will turn business needs into scalable solutions.    Key Responsibilities  • Develop and customise AI solutions for the market, from prototype through to production ownership.  • Be curious and prepared to self-learn to use generative-AI to build agents that make a difference to our business  • Identify automation and decision-support opportunities across customs and business processes, and size them honestly before building.  • Design solutions using generative AI and large language models — retrieval, tool calling, structured extraction from customs documentation, and agentic workflows where they genuinely fit.  • Own the evaluation. Define how we know a solution is working before it ships, and how we know a change has not made it worse. This is treated as core to the role, not an afterthought.  • Manage pilots and implementation, and set the criteria for killing a pilot as clearly as the criteria for scaling it.  • Monitor performance, inference cost, latency and business impact.  • Collaborate with local teams, Group functions and technology partners.  • Contribute to privacy, security and AI governance compliance, working with Group Legal and IT Security. You should understand how the EU AI Act applies to what you build, and be able to produce the documentation that goes with it.  .  Requirements  Essential  • 1-2 years AI engineering, software engineering or intelligent automation, including LLM or AI features that real users depended on.  • Strong Python and SQL, with production code ownership. Not familiarity.  • Demonstrable experience integrating large language models into production systems — prompt and context design, retrieval-augmented generation, structured output, and handling failure gracefully.  • Practical experience with at least one major cloud AI platform (Azure AI, AWS Bedrock, or Google Vertex).  • Solid full stack backend engineering fundamentals — APIs, data pipelines, testing, CI/CD. Most of this job is  • Strong communication skills — you will spend real time with operations staff who are experts in customs and not in AI.  • Professional fluency in English.    Desirable  • Evaluation engineering: building eval harnesses and regression suites for non-deterministic systems, LLM-as-judge approaches, and human-in-the-loop review design. This is the single strongest signal we look for and we will weight it heavily.  • Context engineering: designing and version-controlling what a model sees — retrieval strategy, memory, tool descriptions, and policy layers that constrain what an agent is allowed to do.  • Agent orchestration frameworks and standards (LangGraph, MCP, Temporal or equivalent), and experience with long-running or multi-step agent workflows.  • Observability and cost control for inference at volume.    What success looks like in your first year  • By month three: You understand our customs processes well enough to challenge what we ask for, and you have shipped one small, useful thing.  • By month six: At least one AI solution is live, measured against a baseline, and demonstrably better than what it replaced.  • By month twelve: There is a working evaluation process others can use, a ranked pipeline of next opportunities, and at least two colleagues outside IT operating what you have built without you in the room.    What We Offer  • A key role in shaping AI capabilities.  • The opportunity to build solutions with direct business impact, on real operational volume rather than pilots that never leave the lab.  • An international and fast-evolving environment, with peers in other Customs Support Group markets working on the same problems.  • Professional growth opportunities, including a budget for conferences, certification and model/compute costs for your own experiments.  • Permanent role. Hybrid working.

title: Tech Lead Marketplace Experience (m/w/d)
description: Über die Position   Gestalte mit uns die digitale Infrastruktur des europäischen Gartenbaus   Connected Growers entwickelt June  - die Plattform, über die Erzeuger, B2B Käufer und Vermarkter effizient zusammenarbeiten. Wir ersetzen fragmentierte Prozesse durch moderne Software und schaffen eine gemeinsame digitale Infrastruktur für eine ganze Branche.    Dafür suchen wir Verstärkung als Tech Lead Marketplace Experience (m/w/d), um nicht nur Software zu entwickeln, sondern ein Team aufzubauen, technische Verantwortung zu übernehmen und gemeinsam mit dem Produkt-Team die Zukunft unserer Plattform zu gestalten.   Deine Rolle bei June   Als   Tech Lead Grower Marketplace Experience (m/w/d)   verantwortest du die technische Entwicklung unseres Marketplace und der dazugehörigen Services. Du berichtest direkt an unsere CTO Anna.    Du baust einen neuen Engineering Squad von Grund auf auf und übernimmst die technische und fachliche Verantwortung für einen der kommerziell wichtigsten Bereiche von June. Es geht nicht nur darum, gute Software zu bauen: Du setzt technische Richtung, triffst Entscheidungen unter Unsicherheit, entwickelst Menschen, und prägst die Kultur deines Squads. Du sorgst gemeinsam mit dem Produkt-Team dafür, dass wir Funktionen entwickeln, die für unsere Kunden messbaren Mehrwert schaffen.    Wir geben dir den Kontext und den Freiraum, den du brauchst, um deinen Bereich eigenständig zu führen. Im Gegenzug erwarten wir, dass du Verantwortung übernimmst, Entscheidungen triffst und auch für ihre Konsequenzen einstehst – in einem dynamischen Umfeld, in dem sich Prioritäten verändern und Informationen nicht immer vollständig vorliegen.    Du bist kein klassischer People Manager. Du führst über technische Tiefe, Klarheit, Entscheidungen und Vertrauen. Du bleibst hands-on im Code, ohne zum technischen Bottleneck zu werden, triffst Architekturentscheidungen und unterstützt dein Team dabei, gemeinsam hochwertige Software zu entwickeln.    Unser Marketplace basiert auf dem   Spryker Commerce OS  . Du entwickelst ein klares Verständnis dafür, wann wir innerhalb der Spryker-Konventionen arbeiten, wann wir erweitern und wann eine individuelle Lösung sinnvoll ist. Dabei behältst du immer die langfristige Wartbarkeit und Erweiterbarkeit unserer Plattform im Blick.     Anforderungen   Was du mitbringst     Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung als Tech Lead oder Senior Engineer in Web- und E-Commerce-Anwendungen sowie fundierte praktische Erfahrung mit PHP und Spryker Commerce OS und weißt, wann du innerhalb der Spryker-Konventionen arbeitest, erweiterst oder bewusst davon abweichst.      Du bringst Erfahrung mit API- bzw. Spec-first-Entwicklung sowie mit AWS-Cloud-Infrastrukturen, modernen Deployment-Prozessen und Monitoring mit.      Du hast bereits Erfahrung im Teamaufbau und weißt, worauf es ankommt.      Du hast Verständnis, Interesse und Lust an Produktentwicklung (Software) und Teamentwicklung (Menschen).      Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, kommunizierst klar, hast hohe Qualitätsansprüche und sprichst fließend Deutsch sowie sehr gutes Englisch.     Das wäre ein Plus     Gute Kenntnisse in TypeScript.      Erfahrung mit ERP-, Warehouse- oder Commerce-Systemen.      Erfahrung mit komplexen Order-, Pricing- oder Inventory/Catalogue-Prozessen.      Erfahrung in einem Startup oder schnell wachsenden Technologieunternehmen.       Aufgabenbereich   Was du bei uns bewegst     Du verantwortest Architektur, technische Qualität und Weiterentwicklung des Marketplace und seiner Services.      Du baust dein Squad auf, entwickelst deine Teammitglieder weiter und schaffst eine Kultur aus Ownership, Pragmatismus und kontinuierlichem Lernen.      Du entwickelst eine klare technische Strategie für den Produktbereich Marketplace Experience und triffst bewusste Entscheidungen darüber, wie wir Spryker einsetzen und erweitern.      Du arbeitest eng mit dem Produkt-Team zusammen und übersetzt die Bedürfnisse unserer Käufer und Verkäufer in nachhaltige technische Lösungen..      Du sorgst dafür, dass dein Team Software kontinuierlich, sicher und zuverlässig ausliefert – von der technischen Spezifikation und Architektur über API-Design und Entwicklung bis hin zu Betrieb, Incident Management und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung.      Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Performance, Stabilität, Security und Compliance und stellst sicher, dass technische Risiken früh erkannt, bewertet und bewusst adressiert werden.      Du nutzt AI selbstverständlich im Engineering-Alltag und hilfst deinem Team dabei, AI sinnvoll und verantwortungsvoll für Entwicklung, Testing, Dokumentation und Code Reviews einzusetzen.     So arbeiten wir   Unsere Teams verantworten ihren Produktbereich komplett: Architektur, API-Design, Entwicklung, Betrieb, Incidents, Security, Compliance. Die kommerziellen KPIs gehören dazu.    Wir reden mit Kunden, fahren zu ihnen raus, testen unsere Lösungen dort im Betrieb. Verantwortung endet nicht am Merge-Button.     Die Perspektive

title: Solution Architect H/F
description:
Une révolution en marche   
  Chez Thiga, nous sommes convaincus que l’adoption du Cloud et de la GenAI ne se limite pas à “déployer sur Kubernetes” ou à “brancher un LLM”. Elle exige de repenser l’architecture, l’exploitation et la sécurité : des plateformes cloud natives, observables, résilientes, et capables d’industrialiser des systèmes à grande échelle.  
  Notre vision  
  Nous croyons que l’IA et le Cloud vont redéfinir :  
  L’Architecture Logicielle :   passage d’applications “cloud-ready” à des plateformes   cloud-native   pilotées par l’événementiel et des briques GenAI (agents, retrieval, automatisations)  
  Cloud :   émergence d’expériences basées sur des plateformes cloud, soutenues par des backends sécurisés (tooling, IAM, audit) et des architectures orientées “self-service” et “on-demand” pour offrir du multi-tenant, de l’event-driven, de l’API-first   
  Le Product Engineering :   intégration native de   capabilities Cloud et GenAI   dans les produits, avec des exigences non négociables de   SLO, sécurité, conformité et coût  
   
  Une opportunité unique  
   
  Nous sommes Market Maker. Nous montons une Task Force R&D pour passer du “POC” à la “Production-Grade App on Cloud”.  
  Nous recrutons des   Consultant.e.s Solutions Architects   capables de concevoir des plateformes et des architectures qui deviendront les standards de nos clients : Cloud, DevOps, SRE, sécurité et industrialisation de la GenAI.    Votre mission :  
  -->R&D et Innovation :  
  Architecturer des plateformes Cloud & GenAI :  concevoir des architectures de référence (multi-tenant, event-driven, API-first) pour implémenter des produits de manière robuste et sécurisée 
  Optimisation Coût / Latence / Fiabilité :  définir des stratégies de performance et de FinOps (caching, autoscaling, serverless vs containers, CPU/GPU scheduling, multi-modèle pour l’IA) et mesurer l’impact sur les SLO 
  Data & Retrieval on Cloud :  penser le socle data pour le cloud ou la GenAI 
  Approches “build vs buy” :  évaluer et intégrer des solutions managées vs self-hosted, avec un cadre de décision pragmatique 
  -->Expertise technique  
  Industrialisation (DevOps / SRE / Platform Engineering) :  mettre en place une plateforme de delivery (CI/CD, GitOps, IaC) et des environnements reproductibles pour applications Cloud classiques et les workloads IA 
  Sécurité & Compliance by Design :  implémenter IAM, secrets management, chiffrement, network policies, audit, data boundaries, et optionnellement pour l’IA red teaming, et des garde-fous GenAI (content filtering, prompt injection mitigation, output constraints) 
  Observabilité & Fiabilité :  construire le socle d’observabilité (logs, metrics, traces, OpenTelemetry), des SLO/SLI, alerting, runbooks et postmortems - et optionnellement  pour les chaînes GenAI (latence, coût, qualité, hallucinations) 
  Audit d’architecture :  analyser la scalabilité des plateformes clients (quotas, rate limiting, contention, coûts, disponibilité, DR/BCP) et proposer des trajectoires de modernisation 
  -->Leadership et influence  
  Tech Leading :  définir des standards d’architecture et d’exploitation (landing zones, patterns d’intégration, golden paths, templates) pour accélérer les équipes. 
  Mentorat technique :  faire monter en compétence les développeurs et SRE sur Cloud, Kubernetes, sécurité, IaC, et industrialisation GenAI (LLMOps, évaluation, gouvernance). 
  Votre profil, vous êtes :  
  Un.e architecte / ingénieur.e senior :  vous avez construit et peut être opéré des systèmes distribués en production (scalabilité, fiabilité, sécurité), pas seulement des prototypes 
  Expert.e Cloud & DevOps :  expérience solide sur au moins un hyperscaler (AWS/Azure/GCP), conteneurs, Kubernetes, réseau, IAM, CI/CD, IaC (Terraform/Pulumi), GitOps. La possession d’une ou des certification(s) sera un plus 
  Excellent.e communicant.e :  vous savez cadrer, simplifier, convaincre et accompagner plusieurs équipes (produit, sécurité, data, dev) sans dogmatisme 
 Des plus optionnels : 
  SRE-minded & pragmatique :  vous raisonnez en SLO, error budgets, observabilité, résilience (chaos engineering, DR), et vous savez arbitrer time-to-market vs robustesse 
  GenAI aware :  vous comprenez les fondamentaux de l’industrialisation GenAI (RAG, évaluation, prompt/tooling, gouvernance, sécurité) et vous savez intégrer ces briques dans une plateforme cloud 
  Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Découvrez :  
 Une opportunité de bâtir des  plateformes Cloud & GenAI  production-grade, pas juste des démos 
 Un environnement technique qui valorise l’ excellence opérationnelle  et l’architecture “clean” 
 Une équipe qui aime la  hard tech , le concret, et la responsabilité de bout en bout 
 Un budget R&D pour tester les dernières technos Cloud/GenAI (gateways, vector DB, LLMs, observabilité, GPU) et pousser des benchmarks 
 La possibilité de définir les  patterns

title: Product Owner / Product Manager Senior (H/F)
description:
En tant que   Consultant.e Senior Product Manager chez Thiga  , tu joues un rôle clé dans l’accompagnement de nos clients sur leurs enjeux stratégiques et opérationnels liés au Product Management. Ta mission ne se limite pas à gérer un produit : tu apportes une expertise et une vision qui permettent à nos clients de progresser dans leur maturité produit.    🚀 Ton rôle  
  Conseiller et accompagner les entreprises  dans la structuration et la transformation de leurs organisations produit (audit, définition de roadmap, coaching des équipes).

 Tu aides les entreprises à  élever leur niveau de maturité produit , en leur apportant une approche méthodologique éprouvée et adaptée à leur contexte. 
 Tu es un  accélérateur de transformation  en accompagnant les équipes vers une meilleure autonomie et une approche centrée utilisateur. 
 Tu favorises  l’innovation et l’efficacité produit  en challengeant les pratiques existantes et en apportant des solutions concrètes. 
  🎯 Ton Profil  
  Tu as  une expérience en Product Management  (minimum 5 ans), idéalement avec un parcours varié (startups, scale-ups, grands groupes, conseil). Delivery et discovery n'ont plus de secrets pour toi.

 Tu as un esprit analytique et stratégique, te permettant de  structurer et transformer des organisations produit . Tu es curieux.se et à l’affût des évolutions du Product Management et des meilleures pratiques du marché. 
 Tu as un très bon niveau en anglais et es capable de travailler dans un environnement anglophone 
 Idéalement tu as intégré l'IA Générative dans ton workflow quotidien (prompt engineering, analyse de données, rédaction de doc) et tu mènes une veille active sur ses impacts pour transformer les pratiques Produit.

 Ton diplôme, ce n’est pas ce qu’on va vraiment regarder, en revanche tu justifies d’au moins 4 ans d’expérience (hors alternance et stage) en tant que Product Owner et/ou Product Manager dans un environnement produit.

  Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? 
 
 
  Tu auras un rôle clé dans la transformation des entreprises  : Tu seras en première ligne pour aider les entreprises à améliorer leur approche produit.  
  Tu bénéficieras d'un cadre d’apprentissage continu  : Chez Thiga, nous investissons dans le développement de nos consultants avec des formations internes, du mentorat et des projets de recherche,

company: walkr - turn your Google Meet walk-friendly
description: Urban Walker   Walkr â London (or another city with strong walkability)   Full-time / Part-time considered Â· On-site (outdoors)          About Walkr   Walkr helps people turn everyday calls and meetings into walks. We started as a small Chrome extension that flags walk-friendly meetings in Google Calendar, and we're building toward a bigger mission: make walking the default way people connect, think and work.  We believe most of what happens in a meeting room could happen just as well, if not better, on a pavement. We're now looking for someone to prove it, on the ground, every day.            The role   We're hiring a full-time Urban Walker: someone whose job is to walk. You'll take Walkr's calls, meetings and thinking sessions outdoors, on foot, in a city with enough walkable area to actually make that work. You'll be our internal proof of concept and our most honest source of product feedback.  Practically, this means:   Taking scheduled calls and 1:1s while walking, using Walkr to flag and organise them  Logging what works and what doesn't: audio quality, routes, weather, pacing, how conversations change when nobody's looking at a screen  Feeding that back into the product directly, you'll be in the room (or rather, on the street) with the team building the features you use  Scouting and mapping walkable routes near our hubs that others on the team can reuse  Occasionally representing Walkr in walking meetings with partners, press or early users          What we're looking for    You live in, or are willing to be based in, a city with genuinely walkable areas (parks, canals, low-traffic streets, decent pavements)  You're comfortable holding a normal, focused conversation while moving, this is a real skill, not everyone has it  You're organised enough to manage a calendar full of outdoor commitments and reroute around weather, meetings and life  You're naturally curious about behaviour change, habits and how environment shapes how we think  Bonus: you already walk a lot and have opinions about it          Why this role exists   Most companies talk about wellbeing and then put everyone back in a chair in a room with no windows. We'd rather have one person whose entire job disproves the excuse that walking meetings "don't really work in practice." If it's your job, it has to work.      What you'll get    A role that pays you to do the thing our product is trying to get everyone else to do  Direct input into what we build next  Flexible hours built around daylight and your city's best routes  The rare chance to put "Professional Walker" on your CV and mean it    Please mention the word **GENEROSITY** and tag RMjEyLjguMjUzLjc3 when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RMjEyLjguMjUzLjc3). title: Wireperson
description: Description   Trant Te-Tech  design, custom build and install a wide range of high quality control panels, motor control centres (MCCs) and automation systems, offering conventional, intelligent and withdrawable systems with outstanding reliability and functionality. We are currently looking for a proven  Wireperson  to join our workshop based near Totton, Southampton.     The Role  The  Wire Person  is responsible for the accurate assembly and wiring of control panels, MCCs, and automation systems in accordance with electrical drawings, specifications, and applicable standards. The role plays a key part in ensuring assemblies meet quality, safety, and compliance requirements prior to inspection and testing. What Youll Be Doing  Technical Responsibilities - Panel & MCC Wiring    Carry out wiring of control panels, MCCs, and automation systems to approved schematics and wiring diagrams.   Install and terminate power, control, and instrumentation cabling.   Assemble and wire MCCs and control panels.   Ensure correct segregation, routing and termination in line with design and compliance requirements.     Technical Support & Collaboration    Accurately interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, BOMs, and general arrangement drawings.   Mark up drawings where required to reflect as-built changes.   Follow work instructions and build documentation.   Work collaboratively with fellow wire-people, testers, and supervisors to meet production targets.   Support improvements in wiring practices, layout, and efficiency.    Provide feedback to supervisors on build issues or potential improvements.    SHE&Q and Compliance    Carry out self-checks and peer checks prior to formal testing.   Identify and report defects, non-conformances or drawing discrepancies.   Work safely in accordance with company H&S procedures and UK legislation.   Maintain a clean, tidy and organised working area.   Use tools, equipment, and PPE correctly at all times.     Key Interfaces:  Internal Interfaces   Workshop Supervisor.   Production Manager.   Test Engineer.   Design & Engineering Teams.   Automation Team.   Stores / Logistic.   Quality Team.   External Interfaces   Clients / Inspectors (as required)   Suppliers (limited)     Core Values   Uphold and promote the Companys Core Values  Care, Trust, Respect and Sustainability.    What Were Looking For  Essential    NVQ Level 3 (or equivalent) in Electrical Installation, Panel Wiring, or Electrical Engineering.   Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and GA drawings.   Working knowledge of electrical safety practices and workshop H&S requirements.   Familiarity with quality-controlled manufacturing processes.   Proven experience wiring control panels, MCCs, or similar electrical assemblies.   Experience terminating power, control, and instrumentation wiring.   Experience working from schematics, wiring schedules, and BOMs.   Experience completing work to high quality and safety standards in a workshop environment.   Applicants must be legally authorised to work in the UK, as we are unable to sponsor work visas for this role.    Desirable    18th Edition (BS 7671) qualification.   Awareness or training relating to BS EN 61439-2:2021.   Manufacturer or industry training on MCCs, switchgear andautomation systems.   First Aid or IOSH Working Safely certification.   Experience wiring MCCs and control panels.   Experience with PLC I/O wiring, automation panels, and instrumentation.   Experience supporting test and inspection activities, including rectification of faults.   Experience working on custom-built, client-specific panel builds.    Why Join Trant ? At Trant Engineering, we deliver complex, high-value engineering and construction projects across the UK. From process and water treatment to energy infrastructure upgrades, we play a key role in delivering and protecting critical national infrastructure  shaping the systems that communities and industries rely on every day.  Our teams design and deliver full EPC solutions, combining technical excellence with practical, hands-on delivery. We offer end-to-end capabilities  from concept and design through to manufacturing, construction and commissioning utilising a continually evolving in-house expertise. This means youll work on projects that are varied, challenging and genuinely impactful.  Our multi-disciplinary teams bring together specialists in civil, mechanical, electrical, process, instrumentation, and control & automation engineering, alongside our in-house manufacturing of control panels, MCCs, PLCs and SCADA systems. With over 1,000 people and a strong, growing pipeline of work, its an exciting time to join Trant. We are committed to helping our people succeed through our Career Development Association, providing structured support, mentoring and clear pathways to help you reach your full potential. title: Freelance Copywriter
description:
CT Marketing Agency is seeking skilled Freelance Copywriters to write high-quality, SEO-driven content for eCommerce and lead generation websites. This is a freelance, project-based writing role. 
   
 The ideal candidate has excellent English writing skills, strong research ability, and experience writing content that follows detailed, client-specific guidelines. Projects commonly include category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, SEO landing pages, and website copy. 
   
  About the Role  
 Our client base is constantly evolving, and writers may create content across a wide range of industries, including: 
 
 Fashion, including mass-market and luxury brands 
 Skincare and beauty 
 Tech and software 
 Finance and investing 
 Law, including family law, divorce, and product liability 
 Education 
 Home improvement 
 Automobiles and motorcycles 
 Health and wellness 
 Medical and clinical fields 
 Digital marketing 
 SEO, PR, advertising, and marketing 
 
 Writers with experience in highly specialized industries such as tech, finance, law, health, medical, SEO, PR, advertising, or marketing are strongly encouraged to apply.   
  Responsibilities  
 
 Write clear, engaging, SEO-friendly content for eCommerce and lead generation websites 
 Create category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, landing pages, and website copy 
 Research client industries, products, services, audiences, and competitors 
 Follow detailed client guidelines and adapt to different brand voices 
 Blend SEO best practices with brand priorities and conversion-focused writing 
 Complete assignments by deadline and communicate professionally with the team   
 
  Qualifications  
 
 Excellent English writing, grammar, editing, and proofreading skills 
 2 to 4 years of professional, non-academic writing experience preferred 
 Strong understanding of SEO writing best practices 
 Ability to research unfamiliar industries and technical topics 
 Ability to write creative, engaging, accurate, and ROI-focused content 
 Portfolio featuring published work preferred 
 Experience in specialized industries strongly preferred   
 
  Compensation  
 Writers are paid on a per-word basis. Rates are assessed according to our KPI rubric. 
 Initial compensation is up to $0.06 per word, with $0.034 per word being the most typical rate 
 This equals approximately $30 or $17 per 500-word page 
 After 400 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.064 per word, with $0.038 per word being the most typical rate 
 After 800 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.07 per word, with $0.044 per word being the most typical rate 
   
  Application Process  
 Candidates should be prepared to provide a portfolio featuring published work. Once an offer is extended, writers will complete a brief training course.

title: Senior Independent Software Developer
description:
You must be located in the Americas, Europe, or Israel to apply.     A·Team  is a VC-backed, stealth, application-only home on the internet for senior independent software builders to team up with hand-picked, high-growth companies on their next big thing.  
 After talking with hundreds of independent engineers, designers, and product folks, we heard over and over that finding vetted, high-quality, consistent clients is hard, and projects are often too small to be rewarding. A·Team matches small teams of the most talented builders in the world with companies backed by a16z, YC, Softbank, General Catalyst, etc. on a contract basis for many of their most important initiatives. We quietly launched in May 2020, and have helped A·Teamers earn $85+ million since. 
   As part of A·Team, you can expect:   
 
  High-paying, meaningful missions with the most audacious companies  sent your way; generally $90-$150+/hr, with vetted, fascinating clients doing work that matters. We're picky about who we partner with; new clients only come in via trusted referral. We've worked with Lyft, McGraw Hill, ClearCo, Pepsi, Walmart, the former CEO of Waze, the leading vaccine production software, several new unicorns we can't say here, and dozens of startups backed by a16z/YC/Softbank/Insight/Tiger/etc. 
  Work alongside friends old & new:  our niche is small/diverse product teams, since clients with larger budgets and higher-impact work tell us they want teams, not individuals. Of course, we keep friends together whenever we can. 
  Full autonomy:  say "no" to things that don't excite you. The most talented builders often juggle a few things at once, so there's never pressure to join an A·Team mission if you don't have the bandwidth. If we're no longer a fit, it's easy to leave or pause too.  
  Small, curated, off-the-record gatherings:  for conversations hard to have elsewhere. Long-term, we're creating micro-communities for the world's top builders to become friends around the things they care about. 
  Keep 100% of what you earn:  if you charge $120/hr, you get $120/hr. A·Team makes money by charging a small, flat, transparent platform fee on  top  of your rate. 
 
   
   
   How to apply:   
  Go here:  https://build.a.team/remotivereferral  + mention Remotive.  We respect your time so the application is short. We're also much more interested in seeing what you've made, and excited to chat more if there’s a fit. 
   What you’ll do:   
 
 
  Once part of A.Team, you’ll regularly be invited to impactful missions that match your interests. Find the right pick from early-stage incubations with world-class founders, to fast-growing super-funded companies, to old school non-tech incumbents looking to build as a tech giant would  
 
 
  Missions usually involve building an ambitious piece of software from 0 to 1 as part of a small 3-4 person team.   
 
 
  You’ll be paid to scope it out, give the client options, guide strategy, and execute on the selected solution. Sometimes the client has a clear vision, sometimes not; which is why A.Team builders tend to be senior folks who can work together to find the right direction.   
 
 
   Who A  ·  Team is for:   
 
 
  Senior software developers who left large companies and high-growth startups to pursue their craft with autonomy.  
 
 
  Those who prefer consistent contract work over a full-time role, who want to create a variety of new products alongside other top-tier builders.  
 
 
  The majority of A.Teamers spend most of their time doing independent work, but a sizeable percentage are either employed full-time (but testing out client work), bootstrapping a side project, or looking for their next big thing  
 
 
   Who A  ·  Team is   not   for:   
 
 
  People looking for small gigs  
 
 
  Folks looking to build simple wordpress/wix/squarespace-style websites  
 
 
  Those still early in their careers (<4 years) and recent university/bootcamp grads (at least not yet)  
 
 
   Our long-term vision:   
   A·Team  is a new type of company for a new kind of independent software builder. We call them "unhirables": people who traditional companies couldn’t hire full-time even if they wanted to, but who want to do their most meaningful work with their favorite people in small, autonomous, distributed expert teams.   
  To help us secure amazing missions, we raised $60 million+  from Insight Partenrs, Tiger Global, NFX, RocNation, along with the former CEO of Upwork, the founders of Fiverr and Lemonade, Apple's Global Head of Recruiting, YC Partner Aaron Harris, Wharton's Adam Grant, and Duke's Dan Ariely.

title: Head of Marketing & Communications
description:
We are hiring a  Head of Marketing & Communications  to tell the garden3d story across the internet, from wherever in the world you happen to be.  
  More details if you check our  original job posting link   
  About  garden3d   
 We are worker owned creative collective, innovating on everything from brands and IRL communities to IoT devices and cross platform apps. We share profit, open source everything, spin out new businesses, and invest in exciting ideas through financial and/or in-kind contributions. 
 Our client roster includes  Google ,  Stripe ,  Figma ,  Hinge ,  Black Socialists in America ,  ACLU ,  Pratt ,  Parsons ,  Mozilla ,  The Nobel Prize ,  MIT ,  Gnosis ,  Etsy  &  Gagosian . 
 We’re the software team behind innovative products like  The Light Phone  &  Mill , and we operate a global, decentralized community space collective called  Index Space . 
 We think of our garden3d as collective for creative people, prioritizing a happy, talented, and diverse studio culture. We work on projects that bring value to our world, and we balance deep care for the work we do with a genuine curiosity about life outside of our jobs. 
  Sanctuary Computer  — Development 
 At  Sanctuary Computer  we’re building a different type of technology shop – one that prioritizes close collaboration between the client and the craftsperson. 
 Our projects range from design-forward websites, to robust web apps, to native mobile development. 
  XXIX  — Design 
 When we started  XXIX  in 2013, we set out to create a different kind of design studio and we’ve thrived because we continually ask what a creative practice can be. 
 We’re building a radically different kind of organization that values autonomy, growth, transparency, and shared responsibility. 
  Index Space  — Community 
 A network of physical spaces all around the world,  Index  provides space for the exchange of knowledge and tools. 
 We nurture trust within the creative community through generosity and abundance of ideas and care. 
   garden3d TK   — Media 
 At garden3d, we’re in the early stages of building an experimental media company exploring emerging themes related to the evolving landscape of technology, design and culture. 
 We aim to monetize this outlet, publish books, produce screenplays, and release music. 
 Plus, our partner organizations  https://www.thelightphone.com/   https://www.mill.com/   https://www.ingredient-ai.com/  
 The Head of Marketing & Communications Role 
 The garden3d Head of Marketing & Communications has one mandate: make sure everything we put on the internet is compelling and interesting. garden3d is a house of brands - Sanctuary Computer (development), XXIX (design), Index Space (community), USB Club (digital community), and the garden3d umbrella itself - and each needs its own voice, its own audience, and its own drumbeat of work worth sharing. Working in close partnership with our founder & president  Hugh Francis , this person decides what we make, where it runs, and whether it clears our bar. 
   
  You can be based anywhere.  A lot of our studios, spaces and people gravitate around New York, so there's some pull to be here, and a good part of this job is noticing what's happening in our world and turning it into content. But we already work across timezones, and we would happily hire in Europe, Singapore, Chicago, or wherever you are. If you're the right person, we want to hear from you. 
   
 This role will interface with studio leads, designers, developers, editors, animators, photographers, community managers, event producers and ad platforms across every garden3d vertical. 
 Simply, this person can easily context shift between our massively diverse set of workstreams, find the most compelling stories, and get them produced at an exceedingly high bar. 
   
 This person owns our channels end to end: the  garden3d Substack , our podcast, Instagram, X, and the paid accounts behind them. They collab with our team, and a rotating cast of freelance editors, designers and animators, and they run the calendar that keeps a dozen workstreams shipping on time. They think in PESO terms (paid, earned, shared, owned) with the weight on shared and owned media - paid is a tool they use deliberately, and traditional press is a bonus, but not generally where we focus. 
   
 The ambition runs past marketing a services business. garden3d TK is our young experimental media company, and this role is its engine: books, screenplays, music, media, activations: a record label for ideas. The ideal candidate looks at a worker-owned collective with four studios, a network of community spaces and an open P&L and sees the best content brief on the internet. 
   
  Responsibilities & Mandates  
 ‍ Quality never less than 8/10  
 We aspire for 10/10, celebrate 9/10 and never publish anything that’s not an 8/10 - visually, narratively, and in production quality. This person holds that bar across every post, video

title: Face Deduplication Collection
description:
The project compensation rate is $0.55 USD per accepted image.   The objective of this project is to collect a large and diverse dataset of current neutral selfies, head-pose captures, and historical facial images to support machine-learning research and facial recognition model training at TELUS. 
   
 The focus is on capturing real-world variation across lighting, poses, expressions, accessories, environments, and aging to improve model accuracy and robustness. The collection includes: 
   
 • Current Neutral Selfies – clean frontal selfies serving as high-quality identity references, with natural variation in appearance and surroundings. 
 • Current Head-Pose Captures – selfies captured in assigned head directions to introduce pose variation. 
 • Historical Images – older photos from participants’ galleries to capture natural aging and long-term appearance changes. 
   
  To qualify for payment, you must submit a minimum of 20 valid images.  The maximum payout is based on 24 accepted images. Due to the strict automated and manual Quality Control (QC) process, we strongly recommend submitting 30 images to help ensure that enough images remain valid after review 
   
  Note:   Please use a Gmail address as your primary account when applying for this project.   
   
 Qualification path 
   
 No specific education is needed to perform the project task.

title: Remote Office Assistant
description:
Coalition Technologies is seeking a reliable, detail-oriented, and highly organized Remote Office Assistant to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, data entry, and internal operations tasks. This role is ideal for someone with strong communication skills, discretion, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn and grow within a fast-paced remote work environment. 
 As an Office Assistant, you will help support daily administrative operations, assist with entry-level bookkeeping, organize client documents, support internal reporting, and help maintain accurate company records. This position offers strong growth potential for the right candidate, including opportunities for advancement within the Accounting team or other departments. 
 We are looking for talented and diligent candidates who perform well on our skills assessments. Strong skills test performance may be considered even if a candidate does not meet every preferred experience or educational background requirement. 
   
  Why Join Coalition Technologies?  
 Coalition Technologies is committed to delivering high-quality work for our clients while providing our team with a fun, thriving, innovative, and growth-focused work environment. We offer: 
 
 100% remote work with a company that has supported remote team members for more than a decade 
 Competitive profit-sharing bonus plan, with up to 50% of company profits paid to full-time employees each month 
 Competitive Paid Time Off plan that supports work-life balance 
 Subsidized gym memberships 
 Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance packages for eligible US-based team members 
 International Health Insurance Reimbursement Program for eligible international team members 
 Device upgrade and learning reimbursement programs 
 Career development plans with clearly defined goals and rewards 
 Additional job-specific incentives and bonuses 
 
   
  Office Assistant Responsibilities  
 As an Office Assistant, your duties will include: 
 
 Answering phones and emails 
 Completing entry-level bookkeeping tasks, including recording expenses, organizing receipts, and maintaining transaction records 
 Resolving billing issues with clients and internal team members 
 Providing account access, usage reports, data analysis, and other ad hoc support for team members 
 Supporting quality assurance checks for internal and client-facing reports 
 Organizing new client contracts, creating invoices, and processing client payments 
 Contributing to internal database maintenance, upkeep, and data entry 
 Researching, ordering, and distributing company-wide gifts two to three times per year 
 Organizing company events, competitions, and special projects throughout the year 
 Facilitating company holiday calendars, time-off calendars, and schedule variation calendars 
 
   
  Required Skills and Qualifications  
 The ideal candidate will have: 
 
 Willingness to learn, grow, and collaborate with the team and company as a whole 
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills 
 High level of discretion, ethics, and trustworthiness 
 Strong attention to detail and organizational skills 
 Ability to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, and data entry tasks 
 Innovative thinking and willingness to challenge existing methods when improvement is possible 
 Availability to work 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Pacific Time 
 Reliable remote workspace with a fast computer, quality internet, camera, microphone, and speakers 
 
   
  Preferred Skills  
 
 The following experience is preferred but not required: 
 Intermediate spreadsheet skills 
 Experience with bookkeeping or financial record keeping 
 Experience with Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, QuickBooks Online, and Google Workspace 
 Experience supporting billing, invoicing, reporting, data entry, or administrative operations 
 
   
  Remote Work Environment  
 Coalition Technologies is a fully remote company. Our team works remotely with the support of time tracking software, structured communication, and a company culture designed to help remote team members succeed. We have supported remote team members for more than a decade and welcome qualified applicants from around the world. 
   
  Growth Opportunity  
 This position offers a strong opportunity for growth. Successful Office Assistants at Coalition Technologies have advanced quickly and earned promotions within the Accounting team and across other departments. 
   
  Compensation  
 For candidates located in California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, the starting base pay for this position ranges from $15 to $25 per hour. Compensation may vary based on factors such as experience, qualifications, skills test performance, geographic location, and seniority of the position offered. For candidates outside of California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, compensation may fall outside the listed range.

title: Tier III Service Desk Engineer

 We are looking for an experienced Tier 3 Service Desk Technician with exceptional problem-solving skills. You will serve as the escalation point within the team, resolving complex technical issues while also leading client onboarding and project initiatives. You are expected to be involved in direct end-user support when required. If you have a passion for ensuring top-quality user support and thrive in a collaborative environment, this role is for you.

 ·         Develop project plans for client onboarding and standardization projects, outlining tasks, resources required, and estimated timelines 
   
 ·         Install, configure, diagnose, test and resolve technical hardware and software issues

 ·         RMM – Intune / Immybot 
   
 ·         Networking – Meraki

 ·         Security Cameras – Rhombus / Avigilon 
   
 ·         Door Access – Avigilon

 ·         Client-oriented approach with a passion for delivering high-quality customer service 
   
 ·         Proven experience leading IT projects 
   
 ·         A self-starter who is eager to expand their qualifications 
   
 ·         Background in providing direct end-user support 
   
 ·         High level of attention to detail 
   
 ·         Excellent verbal and written communication skills 
   
 ·         IT-related degree and/or certifications (Cisco, A+, Network+, Microsoft, or equivalent)

  Our Core Values  
   
   Dream Big, Then Make it Real   
   
 We flex our imagination and challenge ourselves to a higher standard.  Do, rather than talk and tell.

 Clients trust us to find solutions that deliver exceptional results.  When they succeed, we succeed.
